beats.narration_text: According to Ruben Hassid at how-to-ai.guide — who ran these comparisons himself — here are eight panels where ChatGPT and Claude diverge. This is his opinion, not a lab study. Let's see what he found.

card.sub: Source: Ruben Hassid / how-to-ai.guide. Author's opinion — not a controlled study. Run your own test.

beats.narration_text: Panel one: Skills. ChatGPT Skills versus Claude Skills. Ruben's read: same thing, same job, you can transfer a Claude skill to ChatGPT with one prompt. His opinion — Claude is the original. Panel two: Model choice. ChatGPT gives you thirty model combos to decode. Claude gives you one model picker. Less choosing, more doing.

Body: ChatGPT column shows a chaotic stack of 30 badges; Claude column shows one clean selector pill. Footer: 'Less choosing = more doing.'

panels.body: Same job, same setup — transfer with one prompt.

beats.narration_text: Panel three: Pricing ceiling. ChatGPT stops at twenty dollars — no tier above it. Claude sells a hundred-dollar seat with virtually no usage wall. Ruben's line: 'Their out-of-usage wall versus I never hit my limits.' Panel four: Speed. Same task. ChatGPT Sol-5.6 finished in sixteen minutes. Claude Fable 5 finished in thirteen. Ruben says Fable 5 was more to the point. Don't trust him alone — run it on both yourself.

beats.narration_text: Panel five: Cowork. Ruben's view — ChatGPT Work is a copy of Claude Cowork. Agents doing your tasks. If you know one you know both. Don't re-learn, just start. Panel six: Coding. ChatGPT Codex and Claude Code both do the same thing — coding agents. Ruben says both beat ChatGPT Sites for a full website build. Either works.

beats.narration_text: Panel seven: the clean split. ChatGPT for images — Ruben calls it unbeatable at image generation. Claude for work — sharper on actual tasks. His shorthand: images on ChatGPT, everything else on Claude. Panel eight: the pricing cliff. Past one-hundred-and-fifty seats, both ChatGPT and Claude flip to pay-per-token. One company Ruben cited went from four-hundred-thousand to one-point-four million a year. Stay under one-fifty on both tools.

beats.narration_text: The verdict in one line — Ruben's words, his opinion: images on ChatGPT, everything else on Claude. The model choice is simpler on Claude, the usage ceiling is higher, and the work output is sharper. ChatGPT wins images and is catching up on search.

card.sub: Author's shorthand. Model picker simpler, ceiling higher, output sharper. Run your own test.

beats.narration_text: One thing worth noting before you take this at face value: every comparison here is Ruben Hassid's opinion and his own testing. The timing claims are anecdotes. The pricing threshold is datable. Check the current plans before making a team purchasing decision.

card.sub: Every panel here is the author's opinion and anecdote. Pricing is datable — check current plans before buying.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Pick one task you currently do on ChatGPT. Run it on Claude this week. Check: was the model selection simpler? Was the output sharper? If yes — move that task. If not — keep it where it works. One experiment, one decision.
